data.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

Write failing tests in `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_loop.py` covering the multi-cycle loop logic.

## Story DD Coverage
- DD3: multi-cycle loop dispatches reviewer agents until PASS / DISPATCH_ARBITER / SHORT_CIRCUIT.

## Specific failing test method names

1. `test_loop_dispatches_three_cycles_then_pass` — mock `cycle_dispatcher.next_action` to return `DISPATCH_NEXT` (cycles 1, 2) then `PASS` (cycle 3); assert reviewer dispatch called 3 times; assert `cycle_ledger.append_cycle` called 3 times; loop exits with exit code 0.
2. `test_loop_exits_immediately_on_pass_cycle_1` — first `next_action` returns `PASS`; assert reviewer dispatch called 0 times (no findings to evaluate; pass per next_action's empty-findings semantics); exit 0.
3. `test_loop_breaks_on_dispatch_arbiter_at_max_cycles` — `next_action` returns `DISPATCH_NEXT` (cycles 1, 2, 3) then `DISPATCH_ARBITER` (cycle 4); assert reviewer dispatch called 3 times (one per non-arbiter cycle); assert arbiter-dispatch hook called once (delegation to T6 wiring).
4. `test_loop_short_circuits_pre_loop_with_prior_arbiter` — ledger has same-SHA entry + arbiter-rulings.json present; assert reviewer dispatch called 0 times; assert exit code matches prior BLOCK presence (1 if any BLOCK, else 0).
5. `test_loop_atomic_ledger_append_per_cycle` — after each cycle, `append_cycle` is called with `(cycle_num, tuples, commit_sha, findings_hash)`; verify each call's cycle_num matches the loop iteration.

## Behavioral assertions

Mock `cycle_dispatcher.next_action`, the reviewer-dispatch invocation (the helper that calls /dso:review or the local code-reviewer agent), `cycle_ledger.append_cycle`. Assert OBSERVABLE outcomes (call counts, exit codes, ledger entry sequence).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] 5 test methods defined with names above
  Verify: cd plugins/dso && python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_loop.py -q --co | grep -c 'test_loop_'   # expect 5
- [ ] All 5 tests fail (loop not yet implemented in local_workflow.main())
  Verify: cd plugins/dso && python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_loop.py -q 2>&1 | grep -E '(FAILED|ERROR)' | wc -l   # expect ≥ 5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_loop.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_loop.py

## File Impact
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_local_workflow_loop.py (new, ~200 lines)
